text:
lauren: quick design review request — API Credentials empty state + revoke/rotate warning placement. mock: https://img.redwood.mock/creds-empty-v3.png. goal: reduce accidental revokes, make CTA clear for create/rotate, and make accessible for screen readers. ready for quick takes? matt: looks cleaner. my top concern: the revoke CTA is visually primary but destructive — we should make rotate/create primary, revoke secondary. anya: agree. also the current banner uses yellow + warning icon, which reads as 'informational', not destructive. if revoke shows in that banner it downplays severity. lauren: good point. thinking: move revoke into a modal with a clear destructive button (red) and an inline helper that explains cascading impacts. modal also needs an undo toast after action. joe: for the empty state CTA ordering: primary = "Create credential", secondary = "Import existing". hide revoke unless there are keys listed. empty state should not show revoke at all. sanjay: accessibility nits: when modal opens focus must land on the modal heading or first actionable element, and the rest of the page should be inert. also add role="dialog" aria-modal="true" and set aria-describedby to the explanatory copy. anya: +1. and for the post-revoke toast, use polite aria-live if it's non-blocking, assertive if we require immediate screen reader attention (I think polite is fine). example: ```
Key revoked.
``` matt: copy suggestions for modal: header: "Revoke credential". body: "Revoking this credential will immediately stop any services using it. If you expect brief interruption, use Rotate instead." actions: [Cancel] [Revoke — destructive]. lauren: rotate flow: show a small checklist before rotate: 1) list services with last-use timestamps 2) show preview of new key name 3) option to rotate gracefully (overlap TTL). This reduces support tickets. joe: microcopy: instead of "Are you sure?" use more specific: "This will immediately invalidate the existing key used by: X, Y, Z." helps reduce accidental clicks. ax-bot: accessibility scan: color contrast of the yellow warning text on 14px body fails WCAG AA (ratio 3.9). suggest darker text (#2b2b2b) or use a darker orange background. Also keyboard-only users need visible focus ring on modal CTAs. lauren: noted. can someone check the spacing on the empty-state illustration vs the CTA? it feels cramped at mobile breakpoints. matt: mobile: stack CTAs, primary full-width, secondary outline under it. keep confirm modals full-screen sheets on mobile. anya: suggestion for undo UX: show toast with explicit 8s timer and 'Undo' button. If undone, show confirmation toast 'Key restored'. If not undone, emit audit log event and brief in-app bell notification for owners. lauren: consensus? actions: matt to update mock with: move revoke to modal, change banner tone, swap CTA order in empty state, add aria attributes. anya to draft final copy for modal and toast. sanjay to write accessibility acceptance checklist. joe to update mobile spec. will reconvene after updates. :thumbsup: matt: on it, I'll post updated frames later today. anya: drafting copy now, will drop in this thread. sanjay: I'll add the axe + keyboard checklist and ping infra for inertness behavior. lauren: thanks team — small follow-up: keep undo window to 10s? open to debate. joe: 8-10s seems reasonable. short enough to limit state, long enough for accidental clicks. lauren: cool. closing for now, will review the next mock. :sparkles:
